_readme: Escalade IQ / IQL catalogue (owner decision B97, 2026-11-19). Neither is in NRCan or EPA (heavy-duty exemption; Consumer Guide: exceeds the weight limit for testing). Figures are GM/Cadillac claims relayed by press because cadillac.com, news.gm.com, news.cadillac.com and news.gm.ca return 403 to the fetcher (not worked around). Source records are in batch-2026-11-19-escalade-iq.json.

generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: 24-module Ultium pack (205 kWh), 350 kW DC, dual-motor AWD, 2025 to 2027. 2025 to 2026: CCS1; 2027: native NACS, 19.2 kW on every trim. Sources: https://gm-techlink.com/?p=19220 ; https://www.carvana.com/buy/2026-cadillac-escalade-iq/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/810603/2027-cadillac-escalade-nacs-home-charging-upgrade/

years.source: https://thenewswheel.com/?p=160231 (production from 2026-12-07, tentative); Canada not confirmed (Cadillac Canada page shows placeholder prices per search result, page itself 403)

models.name: ESCALADE IQL
models.note: Separate nameplate on Cadillac pages (cadillac.com/electric/escalade-iql, cadillaccanada.ca/en/electric/escalade-iql); long-wheelbase body, same 24-module pack. Alternative: keep as trims of the IQ.

generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Long-wheelbase Escalade IQ, same 24-module pack and charging hardware, 2026 to 2027. Sources: https://www.wardsauto.com/news/cadillac-introduces-roomier-escalade-iql/798851/ ; https://www.cars.com/articles/all-electric-2026-cadillac-escalade-iql-follows-in-the-longer-footsteps-of-the-esv-505798

years.source: https://thenewswheel.com/?p=160231 (IQ and IQL production from 2026-12-07); Canada not confirmed

powertrains.name: 205 kWh 800 V AWD
powertrains.note: One powertrain for all three years: no change in pack, chemistry or DC peak found (compared 2025 launch copy, 2026 spec pages via Carvana/Consumer Guide, 2027 via InsideEVs/TTAC). 2026 DC claim rose from 100 to 117 miles in 10 min with no stated hardware change. AC is per trim (11.5 vs 19.2 kW). Rename the id if you prefer the 2025-<slug> pattern.

variants.name: AWD

range.notes: GM: "Cadillac-estimated 460 miles". Launch figure was 450 miles (TechCrunch, InsideEVs). Canada: "over 700 km" (Auto123, relaying Cadillac); no Canadian per-trim or per-wheel figure found. GM publishes one figure per model, not per wheel size; 24-inch wheels with 35-inch tires were the launch configuration.

variants.trim_sources: US: https://www.cars.com/articles/2025-cadillac-escalade-iq-the-electric-icon-starts-at-129990-492255 ; CA: https://www.auto123.com/en/news/amp/2025-cadillac-escalade-iq-pricing-canada/72178/ (AC split by trim is US only)

variants.name: AWD

range.notes: Cadillac Canada: up to 748 km (CarGurus.ca); US: Cadillac-estimated 465 miles (Carvana, Consumer Guide says up to 460). Consumer Guide: one 460-mile claim in normal conditions. Cadillac page also lists Luxury 22-inch / Premium Sport 24-inch wheels but publishes one range per model.

variants.dc_10min: 117 miles in 10 minutes (Cadillac spec page via search excerpt, Carvana); 116 miles (CarGurus US, IQL); 185 km (CarGurus.ca)
variants.trim_sources: US: https://www.carvana.com/buy/2026-cadillac-escalade-iq/ and https://insideevs.com/news/810603/2027-cadillac-escalade-nacs-home-charging-upgrade/ (AC by trim). CA trim names NOT confirmed on a Canadian page (CarGurus.ca does not break out trims); assumed same as US. Lyriq-style: if Canada differs, drop CA names.

variants.name: AWD

range.notes: Advertised 465 miles, powertrain unchanged (News Wheel, relaying GM). GM pressroom (via search excerpt) says EPA estimate not yet available, subject to change before production. low_confidence.

variants.trim_sources: AC 19.2 kW on every 2027 trim: https://insideevs.com/news/810603/2027-cadillac-escalade-nacs-home-charging-upgrade/ . A fifth trim, Signature Sport (24-inch wheels, black roof, same equipment as Premium), is reported by GM Authority and Autofinder, but those pages were not readable (403) / only seen in search results, so it is NOT included; add it if you can confirm it.

variants.name: AWD

range.notes: Cadillac: up to 460 miles (Wards, Cars.com, US) and up to 740 km (CarGurus.ca, Canada). Guide Auto says about 724 km (conflict, not used).

variants.trim_sources: US trims: https://www.wardsauto.com/news/cadillac-introduces-roomier-escalade-iql/798851/ . CA trim names not confirmed (assumed same as US). IQL AC: 11.5 kW standard and 19.2 kW available (Cars.com); the Premium = 19.2 split is estimated from the 2026 IQ.
